description: Main-window capabilities for the roomler-setup wizard: core defaults plus the event-listen permission (the single-instance 'installer-already-running' signal). Without an explicit event grant, Tauri 2 denies plugin:event|listen — which aborted the wizard's listener wiring and left the Next buttons dead (2026-07-17). Nothing else: the page's script is reachable by the user its WebView2 browser runs as, who under over-the-shoulder credentials is not the administrator this process runs as, so an unused grant (a native file dialog, the shell's open) would be a door into that process (FR-129 C). The Rust side opens its own dialogs and links, which no capability gates.
